sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Removes resurrection, wards, invincibility, damage reflection, continuous healing, and damage reduction effects.
-Target: 1 random enemy out of all enemies. Ability Power 210. Success value 100. 10x magic damage (Water).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces DEF and MDEF by 80% for 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Increases physical and magic Ability Power of damage taken by 40 for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Recovers 30 Cost.
-Target: all allies. Applies dual attack, reducing the cooldown time of the next Ability used to 0 (except for certain Abilities).
-Target: yourself. Applies Rage for 60 seconds (increases max HP, ATK, and MATK by 100%; nullifies status ailments and Cost reduction. When in effect, recovers 30% of your character's max HP, recovers 30 Cost, and removes debuffs/special debuffs when you defeat an enemy).
-Applies Pain Collapse (Increases the Ability Power of damage taken by 30) to the enemy Field for 60 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 9000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 9000
